notes.title: Update Ver1.40.0
notes.notes:
The following updates have been implemented.

[Implementation]
- The weather has been implemented and It will change over each turn passed.
- The damage of some attributes may go up or down depending on the weather.
- You can lie on the bed without any special effects.
- A new resolution of 1920 x 1080 has been added to the display option.

[Adjustment]
- It is not able to quit the game by menu from dungeons
  instead changed to return to the title.
- Operation instructions have been changed to depend on the last input device.
- The story part can be skipped by holding the cancel button you pressed.
- Font size became larger and makes it easier to see.
- The probability of ingredients falling from monsters has decreased.

[Bug Fixes]
-Some pad input device does not respond on the title screen
-Fixed other minor bugs

・Added new magic stone "Eclipse" and "Judgment"

・Added a function to lock items

・ Changed the key setting for items sorting

■ Bugs Fix
・ Fixed: Some magic stones have no effect on monsters themselves
・ Fixed: A BUG that the monsters do not consider the terrain appeared in Sound Square
・ Fixed: Could not use an item on the ladder
・ Fixed: A magic stone used for a room that never hit monsters under some condition

・ Others small bugs fix

notes.title: About Game Release
notes.notes:
[b]NonetEnsemble:MagicworkLabyrinth[/b] is scheduled originally to release on February 11, 2020. We decide to postpone the publishing with the aim of further improving quality.

[b]Japanese[/b] and [b]English[/b] languages were planned initially.
In order to make more people enjoy our game, it will also support [b]Chinese (Traditional)[/b] and [b]Chinese (Simplified)[/b] languages.
The release date will be delayed as the main reason for postponing.

Thanks for your comprehension and we are sorry for any inconvenience caused by this decision to those who are waiting for the broadcast.
